security_implications: This chunk defines the SoC‑wide debug policy packet format. The category enum directly controls debug privilege levels, including a locked state and three functional levels. Any undefined encoding on the category field could allow an attacker to bypass access controls if consumers do not reject unknown values. The hardcoded DV parameter SOC_DBG_POLICY_CAT3_VALID supplies a known‑good Category‑3 policy; accidental instantiation in production silicon could permanently unlock Category‑3 debug access.
